name: loom-discipline
description: Claude Code discipline plugin — the canonical home as of v0.1.13 (consolidates make-skills-discipline, which is deprecated). Auto-injects PROBE-first behavior, file:line citation enforcement, dev-tooling-vs-runtime distinction, and friction-as-memory writing into Claude Code sessions via hooks. Includes: (1) UserPromptSubmit hook injecting discipline reminders + auto-recall (SessionStart hook calls /v1/recall and injects top-N memories as additionalContext); (2) Stop-hook agentic-upskilling check (CORE DIRECTIVE 2): if a session crosses the substantive-boundary heuristic (git action / 10+ tool calls + 3+ turns / 30+ turns) without emitting an upskilling report, the Stop hook surfaces *** UPSKILLING PASS NOT RUN ***; (3) Phase 2 local observer (services/architecture-registry's Path A mechanism): when an upskilling report IS present, observer.py parses the report + counts explicit Skill tool calls, POSTs new candidates to the Architecture Registry, PATCHes status as sessions_seen crosses thresholds (draft -> observed at 2 sessions, observed -> recurring at 3+); (4) Phase 2 v2: also parses the upskilling report's 'Promotion candidates' section, emitting Path A candidates with signals.is_new_skill_idea=true. Per-project scope gate honors LOOM_PROJECT_ID (set in .env) AND cwd-substring allowlist. MCP-registers loom-memory at https://loom-agent-context.onrender.com/mcp/memory/ so every session in every project that enables this plugin gets memory_read/write/recall/search/list/delete tools by default. Emits OTLP events to Grafana Cloud LGTM. v0.1.13 (2026-06-14): plugin source moved from the-loom/adapters/claude-code/loom-discipline/ to this marketplace home; make-skills-discipline plugin retired (was a subset; this is the superset).
